text:
Mia: Quick kickoff for VoltPack marketplace onboarding across AWS / GCP / Azure. Primary gaps: images, offer metadata, legal artifacts, and pricing tiers. Can PartnerOps confirm whats already in staging?
PartnerOps: Staging publisher accounts exist. I put creds + links in 1Password partial: <https://1password.com/v/redwood-marketplace-staging>. Uploaded: aws-account-id, gcp-project, azure-tenant.
Sam: Thx. For pricing we need to decide: 14-day trial + per-seat metered, or flat month trial. I lean per-seat meter with a base seat.
Priya: Legal: we need the EULA (redline allowed), a short DPA clause, and export-control blurb. Also confirm telemetry retention (30 vs 90 days) and if we can aggregate.
Oliver: Infra asks: exact AMI name / snapshot id for AWS, GCE image name for GCP, and VHD path for Azure. Also a short terraform outputs list we can plug into the manifest. Example outputs I need: `publisher_account_id`, `listing_s3_bucket`, `kms_key_arn`, `default_instance_family`.
Mia: Assets: SVG logo + 1200x600 PNG, short desc <=240 chars, long desc <=1200 chars, feature bullets, allowed regions (default US/EU/APAC). Also marketing contact + docs URL.
PartnerOps: Images uploaded to staging buckets: AWS snap `snap-0b2c3d4e`, GCP image `voltpack-stg-2026-04-02`, Azure VHD `voltpack-stg.vhd` in storage `rpmarket-images`. Links posted in 1Password.
Sam: Good. I'll draft a manifest skeleton. Two quick fields: do we want to publish recommended GPU family in metadata?
Oliver: Yes add `recommended_instance` and `min_vcpus`. Leave allowed instance set flexible but recommend `g5` family.
Priya: Telemetry policy: 30 days default, aggregated only, PII never collected, opt-out via account page. Legal will provide text.
Mia: Ok action list: 1) PartnerOps - confirm final offerId and publisher display name by EOD tomorrow. 2) Oliver - post TF outputs + instance recommendations by EOD. 3) Priya - upload EULA + DPA drafts by Thu. 4) Sam - publish manifest draft to 1Password under `marketplace/manifests/voltpack.json` and notify when ready.
Sam: Starting manifest now. Small snippet:```json
{"offerId":"<placeholder>","sku":"voltpack-trial","pricing":{"trial_days":14,"model":"per_seat"},"recommended_instance":"g5.xlarge"}
```
PartnerOps: I'll open support tickets with AWS and Azure to pre-warm entitlements. Also posting the publisher portal invite for the product team.
MarketplaceBot: Preflight job scheduled: marketplace-preflight-2060708090 (checks: images, metadata, legal artifacts) ETA 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC.
Mia: If anything blocks the EOD items ping @Mia. We'll do a dry-run publish in staging next Tue.
Oliver: I'll drop the tf outputs + small ARM snippet into the 1Password folder and comment in this thread when done.
Priya: Will upload legal drafts to Google Drive and paste links here when ready.
PartnerOps: Offer metadata posted: offerId `redwood-volt-001`, publisher display `Redwood Inference`, sku `voltpack-trial-v1`. Assets (logos + PNGs) in 1Password.
Sam: Manifest updated with offerId and assets. I'll wait for infra/legal to finish then run the staging upload.
Mia: Thanks team. Follow-up sync Mon 09:30 PT. :rocket:
